title: Doppler Broadening Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for the frequency distribution due to Doppler broadening.

title: Doppler Broadening Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the magnitude of the Doppler broadening in Angstroms.

title: Collision Broadening Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for the collision broadening.

title: Collision Broadening Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the magnitude of the collision broadening in Angstroms.

title: Units and Constants
description: Optional Criteria: The student should use appropriate units and constants throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect unit conversions.

title: Integration Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student should show clear reasoning in the integration steps leading to the frequency distribution.

title: Assumptions Justification
description: Optional Criteria: The student should justify any assumptions made during the calculations.
